extension.description:
Testing only - this add-on may break your system - DON'T INSTALL!
This is a private add-on for Bossanova808's own Kodi systems only. It switches on personal, household-specific behaviour in Bossanova808's skins (custom menus, profile handling and more) that will not make sense - and may not work - anywhere else.
If you have installed it by accident, please uninstall it.
extension.news: v1.0.0 - Initial release - marks a Kodi install as one of Bossanova808's own, so the Bossanova808 skins enable their household-specific behaviour
